I went to a dental clinic near Khu Bon 6 and was very impressed! 😊
The dentist was gentle, explained everything in detail, and didn't feel pressured at all during the procedure. The assistant and staff were friendly and attentive from the moment I entered the clinic. The atmosphere was clean, and the equipment looked new and up to standard.

At first, I was a little scared because I hadn't had dental work done in a long time, but the actual procedure was much more comfortable than I expected. The price was reasonable, and they clearly explained the costs beforehand with no confusing hidden charges.

If you live near Khu Bon, Ram Inthra, or Khlong Sam Wa and are looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend it! 💙
